title: Migration Strategies for Teams
description: Manage Prisma migrations in team environments and handle merge conflicts and branching.

data.text: When multiple developers work on the same codebase, migration conflicts are common. Prisma Migrate provides strategies to handle these situations gracefully.

items: **Divergent migrations** — Two developers create migrations with the same timestamp
**Baseline reset** — Reset the migration history when the schema drifts too far
**Squash migrations** — Combine old migrations into a single baseline for production

data.text: When you encounter a migration conflict, you can use `prisma migrate resolve` to mark a migration as applied or rolled back. This helps keep the migration history consistent across environments.

data.title: Resolve a Migration
data.content: Mark a migration as applied without running it.

data.title: Best Practice
data.text: Pull the latest migrations before creating new ones. If a conflict occurs, communicate with your team and resolve it together before proceeding.
